question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Compute the averages
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        MIN(p.payment_date) as first_payment,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 0
),
customer_7day AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as ltv_7day
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN customer_stats cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cs.first_payment)) / 3600.0 <= 168
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
customer_30day AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as ltv_30day
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN customer_stats cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cs.first_payment)) / 3600.0 <= 720
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cs.total_ltv > 0 THEN COALESCE(c7.ltv_7day, 0) / cs.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) as avg_pct_7day,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cs.total_ltv > 0 THEN COALESCE(c30.ltv_30day, 0) / cs.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) as avg_pct_30day,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_ltv), 2) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_stats cs
LEFT JOIN customer_7day c7 ON cs.customer_id = c7.customer_id
LEFT JOIN customer_30day c30 ON cs.customer_id = c30.customer_id
